title: The pyramids
text: Look at this photo. These are the pyramids of Giza, in Egypt. They are very, very old: more than four thousand five hundred years old!
This big pyramid is the Great Pyramid. It is the tomb of a king called Khufu. In Egypt, the king was called the pharaoh. That small pyramid is the tomb of a queen.
The pyramids are made of big stone blocks. Each block is very heavy: like two cars! Thousands of workers built the pyramids. They used ropes, ramps and boats on the river Nile.
In front of the pyramids there is a big statue. It is the Sphinx. It has the body of a lion and the head of a man. Its nose is not there now.
These pyramids are one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. Today, millions of tourists visit them. Do you want to see them one day?

grammar.title: Grammar: this, that, these and those
grammar.rule: Use this and these for things near you, and that and those for things far from you.
items: Look at ___ photo in my hand.
___ small pyramid over there is for a queen.
___ tourists far away are taking photos.
___ block next to me is very heavy.

es.grammar: Gramática: this / these para cosas cerca (este, estos); that / those para cosas lejos (ese, aquel, esos, aquellos).
